artworks.label: Terracotta armadillo
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for saguaro-siesta. One charming curled desert armadillo made from warm terracotta pottery, elegantly segmented shell with small turquoise glazed geometric inlays, tiny ivory eyes and short rounded clay feet, resting on a minimal warm sand-coloured clay base. Sophisticated handcrafted Southwestern ceramic sculpture, fine unglazed clay texture, turquoise/terracotta/cream palette, soft golden light. No snake, quail, cactus house, agave or text. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
